entities.summary: Wayne Hynes is a Canadian-born German former professional ice hockey player. Hynes competed at the 2001 and 2002 IIHF World Championships as a member of the Germany men's national ice hockey team. He also played ice hockey at the 2002 Winter Olympics with Team Germany.
